descriptions.zh:
**请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解 PDS 的收费方式和[价格](~~425220~~)**。

使用此功能须开通增值服务图片处理功能。故事相关接口限时免费。

用户通过传入指定文件列表创建自定义故事。其中故事类型和故事子类型用户可自定义，不再有约束。

><notice>通过该接口指定故事封面时，该封面文件必须存在于故事列表中，否则会返回错误。></notice>
><notice>自定义故事列表中的文件类型只能为图片。></notice>
descriptions.en:
**Before calling this operation, ensure you understand the billing methods and [pricing](~~425220~~) of PDS**.

To use this feature, you must enable the image processing value-added service. Story-related APIs are free for a limited time.

You can create a customized story by providing a list of files. You can freely define the story type and story subtype.

><notice>If you specify a story cover, you must include the cover file in the story file list. Otherwise, an error is returned.></notice>
><notice>You can include only images in the customized story file list.></notice>
